topic: Mastering Limits: From Intuition to L'Hôpital's Rule

sections.title: The Intuition of Limits: The Squirrel's Path
lecture_lines: The squirrel approaches the tree hollow at x=1.
The path y=(x²-1)/(x-1) shows a missing point.
Height 2 is the destination, the limit L.
animations: Draw squirrel [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/squirrel.svg] moving along curve f(x)=(x^2-1)/(x-1) approaching x=1. (Color: #FFD700)
Draw the graph of f(x) and a hollow circle at x=1, y=2. (Color: #FF4500)
Highlight the coordinate point (1, 2) as the limit value near the tree [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/tree.svg]. (Color: #32CD32)

sections.title: The Rigorous Foundation: Epsilon-Delta Definition
lecture_lines: We define limits using epsilon and delta.
Epsilon sets the vertical target tolerance.
Delta restricts the horizontal input range.
animations: Draw f(x) graph with epsilon-delta target window centered at L. (Color: #FFFFFF) [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]
Animate the vertical target box shrinking to height 2*epsilon. (Color: #FF4500) [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]
Animate the horizontal input box shrinking to width 2*delta. (Color: #32CD32) [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]

sections.title: Indeterminate Forms & L'Hôpital's Rule
lecture_lines: L'Hôpital's Rule uses derivatives of components.
The ratio of slopes reveals the limit.
animations: Draw two curves f(x) and g(x) approaching origin simultaneously. (Color: #FFD700)
Display f'(x) and g'(x) arrows representing the instantaneous slopes. (Color: #FF6347)
Animate the ratio of slopes f'(x)/g'(x) converging to a value. (Color: #32CD32) [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]

sections.title: Conclusion: The Limit Toolkit
lecture_lines: Limits bridge static algebra and dynamic calculus.
